name: Shanghai Museum on People's Square
address: 201 Ren Min Da Dao, Huangpu District (South Entrance on Wusheng Road)
hours: Tuesday–Sunday 09:00–17:00 (last entry 15:00). Also listed: Day & Evening Session 09:00–21:00 (last entry 19:00).
exceptions: During 'On Top of the World Tree: Ancient Civilizations of the Americas' (2026-07-09 → 2027-11-14) this building hosts no other exhibitions; permanent displays are at Shanghai Museum East. Evening sessions must be confirmed on the museum's official WeChat channel.
price: Not published on the visit page — admission terms not captured. FLAG: verify on official booking channel.
booking: Advance tickets via official WeChat Mini Program; overseas visitors may book through trip.com (per official page).
transit: Metro Line 1, 2 or 8 to People's Square, Exit 1; or Line 14 to Dashijie, Exit 4 (official page).
why: Directly across the street from the preferred hotel; free of travel burden on arrival day.

name: Yu Garden (豫园)
address: North gate: 168 Fuyou Road, Huangpu (groups + individuals). South gate: 279 Yu Yuan Lao Jie, Huangpu (individuals only).
closed_days: Closed every Monday (except national statutory holidays)
exceptions: Opening hours during Spring Festival are per official announcement. Monday closure does NOT apply on national holidays.
price: Off-season (1 Jul–31 Aug, 1 Dec–31 Mar): ¥30 per adult. Peak (1 Apr–30 Jun, 1 Sep–30 Nov): ¥40 per adult. Couple = ¥60 off-season / ¥80 peak (2 × adult).
booking: On-site ticket windows at north/south gates, or online via the official 'Shanghai Yu Garden' mini-program.
transit: Not published on the official page. FLAG: verify metro route.
